checks.requirement: Stock the four shelves with the specified products in order.
checks.question: Check which product is on each shelf.
checks.compliant: The top shelf has orange Fizzwell Orange cans, the second has red Fizzwell Cola cans, the third has black Fizzwell Zero cans, and the bottom has Fizzwell Cola bottles.
checks.not_compliant: A shelf has a different product, or a specified product is on the wrong shelf.

checks.requirement: Keep other brands' products out of the Fizzwell cooler.
checks.question: Look for any product that is not Fizzwell anywhere in the cooler.
checks.not_compliant: Any other brand's product is in the cooler.

checks.requirement: Stock only the Fizzwell products specified for Orange Refresh.
checks.question: Look for Fizzwell products other than the four specified shelf products.
checks.compliant: There are no additional Fizzwell varieties or formats in the cooler.
checks.not_compliant: A Fizzwell variety or format not specified in the planogram is in the cooler.

checks.requirement: Keep every shelf stocked across its full width.
checks.question: Check the front row across the full width of every shelf for gaps.
checks.compliant: Products fill the front row across every shelf, with no gaps showing the shelf or back of the cooler.
checks.not_compliant: A missing front-row product leaves a visible gap on any shelf.

checks.requirement: Face products forward with their brand names readable through the door.
checks.question: Check whether the products face forward and show their brand names. A can partly hidden behind the door sticker is not turned away.
checks.compliant: Products face forward with their Fizzwell branding visible through the door.
checks.not_compliant: Products are turned away so their branding does not face shoppers.

checks.requirement: Switch on the interior lights and illuminated FIZZWELL header.
checks.question: Check the cooler's interior lights and illuminated FIZZWELL header.
checks.compliant: The interior lights and FIZZWELL header are lit.
checks.not_compliant: The interior lights or FIZZWELL header are off.

checks.requirement: Show a yellow “3 for £3” promotional label on the top shelf's front edge.
checks.question: Read the top shelf's front-edge price label and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A readable yellow promotional label on the top shelf's front edge says “3 for £3”.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not yellow, or shows different price wording.

checks.requirement: Show a white £1.20 label on the second shelf's front edge.
checks.question: Read the second shelf's front-edge price label and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A readable white label on the second shelf's front edge says “£1.20”.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not white, or shows a different price.

checks.requirement: Show a white £1.20 label on the third shelf's front edge.
checks.question: Read the third shelf's front-edge price label and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A readable white label on the third shelf's front edge says “£1.20”.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not white, or shows a different price.

checks.requirement: Show a white £1.80 label on the bottom shelf's front edge.
checks.question: Read the bottom shelf's front-edge price label and check its colour.
checks.compliant: A readable white label on the bottom shelf's front edge says “£1.80”.
checks.not_compliant: The label is missing, is not white, or shows a different price.

checks.requirement: Display one round orange-and-white ORANGE REFRESH door sticker instead of the ZERO SUGAR SUMMER sticker.
checks.question: Check the door sticker's number, shape, colours and wording, and look for the old sticker.
checks.compliant: There is one round orange-and-white sticker reading “ORANGE REFRESH”, with no visible “ZERO SUGAR SUMMER” sticker.
checks.not_compliant: The ORANGE REFRESH sticker is missing or differs in shape, colours or wording; there is more than one; or the old sticker remains visible.

checks.requirement: Keep the door glass clean and free of anything other than the current door sticker.
checks.question: Check the door glass for dirt, marks or other attached material. Reflections and light glare on the glass are not dirt.
checks.compliant: The glass is clean and has no attached material besides the ORANGE REFRESH sticker.
checks.not_compliant: The glass is visibly dirty or has another sticker, notice or attached material.

checks.requirement: Remove earlier campaign shelf labels, including any “2 for £2” label.
checks.question: Look throughout the cooler for obsolete campaign labels or any “2 for £2” label.
checks.compliant: Only Orange Refresh shelf labels are displayed, and no “2 for £2” label remains.
checks.not_compliant: An earlier campaign label or any “2 for £2” label remains anywhere in the cooler.

not_checkable.requirement: Place the new sticker in the old sticker's exact position.
Remove the old sticker rather than concealing it beneath the new one.
Have the planogram in place by store opening on 5 July.
